changelog: **Own bill links to the published definition (#1735):** the active-pair definition on both billing tabs now links to `/pricing#how-we-count` (`METERING_DEFINITION_HREF` in `src/lib/meteringRules.ts`), the section that publishes how pairs are counted, so a customer can check the number against the published sentence in one click; `e2e/org-billing.spec.ts` asserts the link and that the section states the same rule.

en: On the billing page, "How pricing works" now takes you straight to the section that explains how active pairs are counted.
tr: Faturalandırma sayfasındaki "Fiyatlandırma nasıl işler" bağlantısı artık doğrudan aktif çiftlerin nasıl sayıldığını anlatan bölüme götürüyor.
de: Auf der Abrechnungsseite führt „So funktioniert die Preisgestaltung“ jetzt direkt zu dem Abschnitt, der erklärt, wie aktive Paare gezählt werden.
